data_purpose: Bangladesh rainfall MVP for 1 October 2026 pre-screening
source_provider: NASA GPM / GES DISC via Giovanni
product: GPM IMERG Early Precipitation L3 1 day 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07
variable: Daily mean precipitation rate (combined microwave-IR) estimate - Early Run

spatial_basis.warning: This is a bounding box average, not an exact Bangladesh national-boundary mask.

comparison_baseline.method: same month-day baseline across available years
comparison_baseline.warning: This is not the official NASA 2001-2022 IMERG climatology.

risk_reference.warning: These categories are meteorological reference classes, not a universal disaster-probability score; applying them to an area-averaged satellite value should be labeled as reference context.

audio_mapping.meaning: Equal frequency corresponds to equal mapped rainfall amount under the fixed mapping; it does not mean the physical rainfall itself produces that pitch.
